lines: Sometimes, people follow the crowd even when they know the crowd is wrong.
They are afraid of being different.
They are afraid of being judged.
And they don't want to stand alone.
Here is the hard truth about life.
Just because everyone is doing something doesn't mean it is right.
Don't choose a career just because your friends chose it.
Don't follow an opinion just because everyone believes it.
And accept that sometimes, doing the right thing means standing alone.
Follow for more psychology facts and life lessons that can change the way you see the world.
